name: product-tile
title: ProductTile
description: A product in an order grid. The whole tile is the press target: name and price, or a square photo above them, an owner colour on the start edge, a badge after the price, a sold-out state, and in edit mode a remove control in its corner. ProductTileAdd is the dashed empty position. Renders a react-aria-components Button; look owned in Vanilla CSS.
